thread:
matt: Starting change window canary for service-router v3.4.1 -> eu-west. Rolling 10% to canary. SLOs to watch: p95 < 150ms, 5xx < 0.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated: id=canary-4412349999 target=service-router:v3.4.1 traffic=10% strategy=staggered-10m. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/4412349999 :robot_face:

ana: Watching slo-dashboard and traces. Will call if sustained drift.

luca: Early signal: embeddings-route p95 +45ms vs baseline for eu-west. KV cache hit rate down ~55% (baseline ~98%). No major 5xx yet.

jen: Getting an alert for increased 502s from kvcache shard group (last 60s). Currently ~0.28% but trending up. @matt @ana

matt: Can you check whether failures are concentrated on long sequences? If 5xx > 1% sustained for 3m we pause. No auto-rollforward until cleared.

ana: Traces point to long-seq embeddings (>1k tokens) having tail latencies and TTL lookup timeouts. Short requests look fine.

luca: Snapped metrics:

```
kv_cache_hit_rate: 55% -> 52% (since canary)
embed_route_p95: 215ms (long-seq), 128ms (short)
5xx_rate: 0.31% -> 0.66% (last 2m)
```

deploy-bot: Policy eval: canary-4412349999 p95_threshold_exceeded=true (p95>180ms). Auto-pause triggered.

jen: Initiating pause and tagging rollback candidate. I'll populate rollback checklist but will wait for root cause confirmation before final decision.

matt: Good. Ana, diff artifacts vs v3.4.0 — any kv or cache heuristics changed in patch?

ana: Doing quick diff. Notable: attention prefetch param and a new kvcache eviction heuristic in v3.4.1. That could cause cache churn for long sequences.

luca: If eviction heuristic is culprit, we can bump kvcache window or revert heuristic. Can we try a runtime config bump on canary to repro hit-rate change?

matt: Try config bump first: increase cache window. If p95 doesn't recover <150ms in 5m, plan to rollback to v3.4.0 and pin.

ana: Applied runtime flag on canary: `kvcache.window=5m` (was 2m). Observing.

sre-bot: Observability update: canary-4412349999 p95 -> 140ms (3m after config change). 5xx -> 0.18%.

jen: Looks like the config tweak worked. Recommend keeping canary paused and running a 15m soak before resuming traffic.

matt: Agreed. Pause canary, soak 15m. Ana, please add a line to release notes about the eviction heuristic and the temp config recommendation.

ana: Draft note: "Hotfix: KV cache eviction heuristic in v3.4.1 reduces hit rates for long-sequence workloads. Interim recommended config: kvcache.window=5m until v3.4.2." Adding trace IDs in PR.

luca: After soak, if stable, either proceed with a targeted second canary (heuristic disabled) or rollback+patch. I'd prefer patch branch that reverts heuristic and run unit/integration tests.

matt: Plan: paused + soak 15m. If metrics stable -> second canary without eviction heuristic. If not -> rollback & pin v3.4.0. Update this thread with final decision.

jen: I'll update incident tracker and notify CS about potential user impact. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary paused (traffic -> 0%). Soak timer started (15m). state=PAUSED id=canary-4412349999.

matt: Thanks. Remember to add a short changelog note and follow-up patch plan.

ana: Release notes PR opened: https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-1288

luca: Creating patch branch to revert eviction heuristic and kick off CI.

jen: Will summarize results after soak and close loop in #all-hands if rollback happens.

matt: I'll post final update in ~15m. Thanks everyone."
